_comment: Extended dashboard: Duration & Flakiness Trends. CONFIRMED against a live RP 5.15.x instance: 'launchesDurationChart' with contentFields ['startTime','endTime'] + widgetOptions.timeline='launch', and 'casesTrend' with exactly ONE contentFields entry (here 'statistics$executions$total'), are both accepted. 'flakyTestCases' requires widgetOptions.launchNameFilter (see failure_defect_breakdown.json comment) -- '%' (SQL LIKE wildcard) matches any launch name.

widgets.name: Launch Duration Trend
widgets.description: Execution duration trend across the last 30 launches -- watch for creeping suite runtimes.

widgets.name: Test Case Growth Trend
widgets.description: Total test-case count across the last 30 launches -- tracks automation coverage growth.

widgets.name: Top Flaky Tests (last 30 launches)
widgets.description: Test cases whose status flips most often between pass/fail across a wider 30-launch window.
